core_meaning.short_meaning: Halo, aura, the glow around the moon
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hala corresponds to the Arabic form هالة (Arabic root ه و ل (h-w-l); هَالَة (Hāla)). Its core sense is halo, aura, the glow around the moon. Hala is Arabic هَالَة (Hāla) 'a halo, a corona of light (especially around the moon), an aura' — a common Arabic feminine name. The source gloss 'mature, ripe' is unsupported and belongs to a different root; it has been replaced with the lexical sense of هالة.
